<br>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is produced through [[Alchemy]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. When used the potion applies the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff, increasing dealt damage.

==Effect==
On use, the potion will apply the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff for a duration of 5 minutes. This buff increases damage dealt to monsters. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
